box: short-stick (/game/short-stick/) — 320px viewport, 10-player roster: usable, nothing overflows horizontally
method: scripts/driver.mjs, one CDP tab, real headless Chrome (--headless --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --remote-debugging-port=9222), against a real build (npm run build + npx serve dist/ -l 4321). Navigated to http://localhost:4321/game/short-stick/, wiped storage on-origin (never about:blank) and verified the wipe by reading localStorage/sessionStorage back empty. Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride to 320x700 via session.setWidth, confirmed by reading innerWidth back from the page (not a --window-size flag, which does not reflow). Seeded a 10-player roster via the start-numbered shortcut (player-count=10, #start-numbered click -> 'คนที่ 1'..'คนที่ 10'), which mounts the stick bundle. Measured document.documentElement.scrollWidth/clientWidth, counted elements whose getBoundingClientRect().right exceeds clientWidth, and read the bundle's own computed flex-wrap and bounding box.

note: 10 sticks at min(44px,13vw)=41.6px width each, gap 0.5rem, inside a 304px-wide bundle wrapped onto multiple rows (bundle height 212.8px, several times a single 112px-tall stick) — confirms flex-wrap:wrap actually wrapped rather than the row silently overflowing. scrollWidth === clientWidth === innerWidth === 320 and zero elements crossed the right edge.
